# graphicwheeler

> Official one-page portfolio of graphicwheeler, also known as Wheelz_TTV: a graphic designer, gamer, streamer on hiatus, and proud girl dad based in Sartell, Minnesota. Local roots in Central Minnesota; work and content for a worldwide audience.

Canonical website: https://graphicwheeler.com/

The public website is a static, single-page site. Its sections use anchors, not separate page routes. There is no login or private content. The factual summary below describes the owner, not an agency or storefront.

## Website sections

- [Video series](https://graphicwheeler.com/#work): What If? and Lost In Space, with featured YouTube videos and links to the complete playlists.
- [About](https://graphicwheeler.com/#about): Minnesota-based designer, gamer, husband, girl dad, and Star Trek fan.
- [Profiles and resume](https://graphicwheeler.com/#elsewhere): Design portfolio, streaming profile, viewing activity, and resume.
- [Contact on socials or in game](https://graphicwheeler.com/#contact): Public social profiles, Steam, and the Xbox gamertag WheelzTTV.

- [Behance portfolio](https://www.behance.net/graphicwheeler): Public graphic design work.
